verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for a public web service like UK Visas and Immigration, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt file, crawler directives, or any agent access policy. The evidence covers only visa routes, fees, processing times and online applications.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
